name: resonite_avatar_control
description: Control Resonite avatar parameters and animations

avatar_path.description: Path to the avatar (resonite://, inventory://, or file://)

parameter_name.description: Name of the parameter to control (e.g., Happy, Angry, Excited)

template: Control Resonite avatar by loading {avatar_path} and setting {parameter_name} to {value} in slot {slot}.

examples.output: Load the default Resonite avatar and set the Happy parameter to 0.8 in slot 0.
Load MyCustomAvatar from inventory and set the Excited parameter to maximum in slot 1.
